subject: GOBACK statement
notes: kb/Work/PB411.md - LANDED. The rule is CONDITIONAL ('If literal-1 is numeric') and the screen honours the conditional in both directions: a non-numeric literal-1 is admitted and a non-integer numeric literal is rejected with COBOL1704 citing SR3/SR7. The PARTIAL was the METHOD arm, which never ran the rule at all - 'GOBACK WITH ERROR STATUS 1.5.' inside a method compiled clean at 2023/2014/2002 because the OO binder re-decoded the parse node and never read g.statusPhrase(). The decode now happens ONCE before the fork (CallBinder.DecodeGobackPhrases) and the method arm takes the decoded record, so the rule is unreachable-proof rather than merely present; the parity theory carries a method-context row for this exact literal and asserts the same diagnostic as the program arm.
